fields.action_text: Ascend the staircase carefully, testing each step
fields.success_text: You ascend slowly, careful not to slip or trigger any unseen traps. Your climb is safe.

fields.action_text: Claim the treasure and step through the portal
fields.success_text: You approach the dais and fill your packs with as much gold and treasure as you can carry. The weight of it is real and satisfying in your hands. With your fortune secured, you turn toward the swirling portal. As you step through, the cold darkness of the castle falls away and is replaced by warmth and light. You cross the threshold and emerge somewhere safe, somewhere far from that place of death and shadow. You are alive, and you are rich. You breathe deeply. The air is fresh and sweet. You open your eyes and gaze at the open sky above, and you think of the castle, sitting silently on its hill, awaiting the next adventurous fool who should dare step foot within…

fields.action_text: Force open the iron-banded door and pass through
fields.failure_text: You wrench at the stubborn door with all your strength. The ancient hinges shriek and something in the mechanism makes a loud *click* — a concealed blade swings from the doorframe above, slashing you across the shoulder.
fields.mixed_text: You manage to force the door wider, but the warped iron scrapes viciously against your side as you squeeze through, tearing cloth and skin.
fields.success_text: With steady pressure applied at just the right angle, the door swings open smoothly. You pass through unharmed.

fields.action_text: Search the altar beneath the windows for valuables
fields.failure_text: You discover a small leather pouch wedged behind the altar containing 100 gold pieces, but dislodging it triggers a mechanism to activate. A hidden panel in the floor drops away beneath your feet. You catch yourself on the altar's edge, wrenching your arm badly in the process. The pouch of gold falls into the abyss below.
fields.mixed_text: You discover a small leather pouch wedged behind the altar containing 100 gold pieces, but dislodging it triggers a mechanism to activate. A hidden panel in the floor drops away beneath your feet. You catch yourself on the altar's edge, wrenching your arm badly in the process. The pouch of gold begins to fall, but you grab it just before it slips beyond reach.
fields.success_text: Behind the altar, you find a small leather pouch containing 100 gold pieces. Your careful searching reveals no further traps or treasures.

fields.action_text: Summon a magical light to lead your way
fields.success_text: You concentrate your thoughts and speak a word of Illumination as magical energy begins to surge through you. Your eyes glow. From your fingertips float small ethereal lights that coalesce into one. The bright magical orb now hovers in the center of the chamber, extinguishing all shadows around it. In the light of the orb, you are able to find a small pouch of gold and a safe path forward.

fields.action_text: Lift the low-hanging tapestry and look behind it
fields.failure_text: Behind the tapestry, you discover a narrow concealed opening just wide enough to enter. As you force your way through, a jagged stone tears at your skin sending a sharp pain down your side.
fields.mixed_text: Behind the tapestry, you discover a narrow concealed opening just wide enough to enter. You slip through uninjured.
fields.success_text: Behind the tapestry, you discover a narrow concealed opening just wide enough to enter. On the ground just inside the opening, you see a small gleaming jewel. You pocket the jewel and slip through the opening uninjured.

fields.action_text: Force open the rusted wooden chest
fields.failure_text: The lid gives way revealing nothing but mold and rot inside. You hear a loud *click* as a hidden mechanism is activated. A dart shoots out from a small opening in the wall and pierces you square in the chest.
fields.mixed_text: The lid gives way revealing nothing but mold and rot inside. You move on.
fields.success_text: The chest opens with a dry crack, revealing a modest cache of coins left undisturbed.

fields.action_text: Walk through the open archway at the end of the hall
fields.success_text: You approach the archway and pass through unharmed.

fields.action_text: Lean over the basin and peer into the dark water
fields.failure_text: The surface ripples violently, and you think you see something glimmering at the bottom of the basin. Entranced, you are compelled to reach into the water, but it isn’t water. It’s acid. And the glimmering treasure, a cruel illusion. You recoil, empty-handed.
fields.mixed_text: The surface ripples violently, but you are sure you see something glimmering at the bottom of the basin. Determined, you reach into the water, but it isn’t water. It’s acid. You snatch the glimmering treasure and recoil.
fields.success_text: The water clears, and you see a silver charm glimmering at the basin’s bottom. You reach in and claim the prize.

fields.action_text: Enter the dark hallway
fields.success_text: Darkness engulfs you as you enter the hallway. You walk slowly and quietly, so as to not disturb the silent things that may be hiding nearby. You proceed safely.

fields.action_text: Pull aside the velvet curtain to reveal what it hides
fields.failure_text: You pull the curtain aside and reveal a stone statue sitting within a small alcove in the wall. The statue looks like… you. You stare into its familiar eyes and begin to feel a pressure inside your mind. The whispering in the chamber grows cacophonous. Some dark energy begins attacking you from within. You scream and pull yourself away, stumbling out of the area in a daze.
fields.mixed_text: You pull the curtain aside and see… nothing at all behind it. Only the cold stone wall, mocking you. Had your eyes been playing tricks? You move on, confused.
fields.success_text: You pull the curtain aside and reveal a what looks to be an ancient jewelry box sitting within a small alcove in the wall. You open the box and see several golden coins, worn smooth by time. You retrieve them and move on.

fields.action_text: Call forth a gentle radiance to still the whispers
fields.success_text: You speak a word of Calm. Light gathers around you, soft and unwavering. The whispering, at first dissonant and incoherent, has now merged into a single soft voice. The voice guides you towards the basin and instructs you to touch several stones at its base in sequence. A hidden compartment slowly opens. Looking inside you see a jeweled pendant covered in ancient dust. You wipe it clean, claim it, and move on.

fields.action_text: Kneel before the stone bench
fields.failure_text: You kneel. Beneath your weight, you feel the floor shift. Sharp pain erupts in your knees as hidden spikes drive upward. You have paid your penance.
fields.mixed_text: You kneel and a hidden compartment opens, revealing a small offering of coins. As you reach for the coins, you feel the floor shift beneath you. Sharp pain erupts in your knees as hidden spikes drive upward. You have paid your penance and have been rewarded.
fields.success_text: You kneel and a hidden compartment opens, revealing a small offering of coins. Your devotion has been rewarded.

fields.action_text: Pass through the narrow iron door
fields.success_text: The iron door creaks loudly as you push it open. You flinch in anticipation of some deadly trap springing into action... but nothing happens. You pass through unharmed.

fields.action_text: Descend the slick stair into the dark below
fields.failure_text: Your footing fails immediately, and you tumble violently down the steps, battered and bruised.
fields.mixed_text: You slide painfully downward but manage to catch yourself before sustaining too much harm.
fields.success_text: You descend carefully, avoiding the worst of the danger.

fields.action_text: Study the runes etched into the fountain basin and test the mechanism
fields.failure_text: You test the runes in sequence. As you press the final rune, a hidden needle snaps from the stone and pierces your finger, immediately drawing blood. The mechanism’s dark purpose has been fulfilled.
fields.mixed_text: You test the runes in sequence. As you press the final rune, a hidden needle snaps from the stone and pierces your finger, immediately drawing blood. The mechanism’s dark purpose has been fulfilled. A small compartment opens at the fountain’s base, revealing several small gemstones. A gift.
fields.success_text: You test the runes in sequence. As you press the final rune, a small compartment opens at the fountain’s base, revealing several small gemstones. A gift.

fields.action_text: Pull the heavy iron chain
fields.failure_text: You pull the chain and hear the sound of hidden gears begin to work within the wall as a small doorway opens. Just then, a concealed blade jolts from the wall and slashes across your side before retracting.
fields.mixed_text: You pull the chain and hear the sound of hidden gears begin to work within the wall as a small doorway opens. Just then, a concealed blade jolts from the wall and slashes across your side before retracting. Something metal drops at your feet: a small ring of old coins.
fields.success_text: You pull the chain and hear the sound of hidden gears begin to work within the wall as a small doorway opens. Something metal drops at your feet: a small ring of old coins.

fields.action_text: Lift the metal grate set into the floor
fields.success_text: You lift the metal grate and see a ladder leading down into darkness. You descend carefully.

fields.action_text: Reach into the pool and search its depths
fields.failure_text: You plunge your hand into the water and immediately feel something wrap around your wrist — cold, slick, and alive. You wrench yourself free, but not before the creature tears at your flesh.
fields.mixed_text: You plunge your hand into the water and immediately feel something wrap around your wrist — cold, slick, and alive. You snatch a small coin purse from the bottom and wrench yourself free, but not before the creature tears at your flesh.
fields.success_text: You reach carefully into the pool and find a small coin purse resting at the bottom. You retrieve it without incident.

fields.action_text: Pry open the iron grate in the wall
fields.failure_text: You wrench at the grate with all your strength. The ancient metal finally gives way, but as it does, something sharp inside the opening slashes across your arm. The glistening object slips out of reach.
fields.mixed_text: You wrench at the grate with all your strength. The ancient metal finally gives way, but as it does, something sharp inside the opening slashes across your arm. You recoil, but not before retrieving the glistening object: a small finely-cut gemstone.
fields.success_text: You carefully work the grate loose and discover a hollow behind it containing a small gemstone, finely-cut and glistening brightly. You claim the prize and move on.

fields.action_text: Push open the wooden door and pass through
fields.success_text: The door swings open easily on well-oiled hinges. You pass through without trouble.

fields.action_text: Cast a spell of Revealing upon the stone figurines
fields.success_text: You mutter an incantation, and the figurines begin to arrange themselves around the dark pool. You feel a small surge of energy as they lock into their proper places. The pool's surface shimmers and becomes transparent as air. At the bottom, you see a leather satchel heavy with coins, and you reach down to claim it without fear. The water feels warm and welcoming against your skin.

fields.action_text: Climb the iron ladder through the ceiling opening
fields.success_text: You climb carefully, testing each rung before putting your full weight on it. The ladder holds, and you ascend safely.

fields.action_text: Crawl through the low archway into the darkness beyond
fields.failure_text: You drop to your hands and knees and begin crawling through the narrow passage. Halfway through, your hand presses down on something that clicks beneath your weight. Stone grinds against stone, and the passage constricts violently, crushing you against the floor before releasing. You drag yourself through, battered and bleeding.
fields.mixed_text: You drop to your hands and knees and begin crawling through the narrow passage. The stone scrapes against your back and shoulders as you squeeze through, tearing cloth and skin.
fields.success_text: You lower yourself and crawl carefully through the archway. The passage is tight but navigable, and you emerge on the other side unharmed.

fields.action_text: Pull open the wardrobe doors and search inside
fields.failure_text: You pull the doors wide and immediately understand the warning. Inside hangs a servant's uniform, but the body wearing it is still there—desiccated, hollow-eyed, and reaching for you with skeletal hands. You stumble backward in horror as it lurches forward, letting out a dreadful hollow scream. Its bony fingers rake across your face leaving deep gashes behind. You run from the area in fear.
fields.mixed_text: You pull the doors wide and immediately understand the warning. Inside hangs a servant's uniform, but the body wearing it is still there—desiccated and hollow-eyed. You shudder at the sight of it. Carefully you search the uniform pockets and find a small coin purse. Just then, the body lurches forward, screaming. Its bony fingers rake across your face leaving deep gashes behind. You run from the area in horror.
fields.success_text: You pull the doors wide and immediately understand the scratched warning. Inside hangs a servant's uniform, but the body wearing it is still there—desiccated and hollow-eyed. You shudder at the sight of it. Carefully you search the uniform pockets and find a small coin purse. Just then, the body lurches forward, screaming. Its bony fingers reach for your face, but you avoid its grasp. You run from the area in horror.

fields.action_text: Whisper a blessing of peace to calm the restless dead
fields.success_text: You close your eyes and speak a word of Peace. The wardrobe doors swing open gently on their own. A servant's corpse slumps peacefully against the back wall, no longer tormented by pain or rage. In its skeletal hand, it clutches a leather purse heavy with coins — an offering freely given. You take it respectfully and move on.

fields.action_text: Wade through the water to the stone steps and climb to the platform
fields.success_text: You wade carefully through the murky water, testing each step before committing your weight. The stone steps are slippery but solid, and you climb to the dry platform without incident.

fields.action_text: Search the collapsed table for anything salvageable
fields.failure_text: You reach toward the waterlogged parchments, hoping to find something of value. As you disturb the pile, something beneath the table writhes to life — a mass of pale, writhing leeches. They latch onto your legs and arms, feeding greedily before you can tear them away.
fields.mixed_text: You sift carefully through the ruined documents. Most have dissolved into pulp, but your fingers close around something solid — a small metal box sealed with wax. You pull it free just as something alive brushes against your ankle beneath the water. You jerk away, but not before it bites. Inside the box, you find several old coins.
fields.success_text: You search the table methodically, keeping your eyes on the water below. Hidden beneath the sodden mess, you discover a small metal box sealed with wax. Inside are several old coins and a tarnished ring.

fields.action_text: Trace the carved symbols on the iron door and push it open
fields.failure_text: You run your fingers along the symbols, trying to understand their meaning. As you push the door open, the carvings glow with a bright and searing heat. You cry out and stumble backward, your burned hands throbbing.
fields.mixed_text: You trace the symbols carefully, and they begin to glow with a soft, warm light. The door swings open smoothly.
fields.success_text: You trace the symbols carefully, and they begin to glow with a soft, warm light. The door swings open smoothly. Inside a small alcove, you find a leather pouch containing coins and a finely-crafted decorative dagger with a jeweled hilt.

fields.action_text: Command the waters to reveal what they are hiding
fields.success_text: You conjure the might of Pontus. The stagnant water begins to churn and swirl, then drains rapidly away through cracks in the floor. In the newly revealed space beneath where the table stood, you see a locked strongbox half-buried in silt. The lock is rusted through and breaks easily. Inside, you find a small fortune in preserved coins and a collection of gemstones that gleam even in the dim light.

fields.action_text: Walk carefully through the archway at the far end of the gallery
fields.success_text: You pick your way slowly across the gallery, avoiding the largest shards of glass. Your footsteps crunch softly, but you reach the archway without incident.

fields.action_text: Approach the intact mirror and examine your reflection
fields.failure_text: You step close to the mirror and gaze at your reflection. For a moment, everything seems normal — then your reflection moves independently. It reaches towards its own neck and begins to choke itself. As it does so, the muscles in your neck begin to tighten, and you find that you can no longer breathe. You tear yourself away, choking and bruised.
fields.mixed_text: You step close to the mirror and gaze at your reflection. It stares back, unmoving, and you notice something odd—behind your reflection, you see a glint of gold that isn't behind you in the real room. You reach toward the mirror's surface cautiously. Your fingers pass through as if into water, and you grab what feels like coins. As you withdraw your hand, the glass ripples violently and shatters. Your hand, badly cut, grips bloody coins.
fields.success_text: You step close to the mirror and gaze at your reflection. It stares back, unmoving, and you notice something odd—behind your reflection, you see a glint of gold that isn't behind you in the real room. You reach toward the mirror's surface cautiously. Your fingers pass through as if into water, and you retrieve a small purse of coins. The mirror's surface stills, and you step back unharmed.

fields.action_text: Clear away the debris and open the wooden chest
fields.failure_text: You clear away the debris carefully and open the chest. Inside, you find a collection of coins. As you dig through them, you feel a sharp prick — a poisoned needle attached to the bottom of the chest, hidden among the treasure. Immediately, your vision swims and your limbs feel heavy. You stagger backwards and stumble away.
fields.mixed_text: You clear away the debris carefully and open the chest. Inside, you find a collection of coins. As you grab a handful, you feel a sharp prick — a poisoned needle attached to the bottom of the chest, hidden among the treasure. You pull back quickly, feeling only slight dizziness.
fields.success_text: You clear away the debris carefully and open the chest. Inside, you find a collection of coins and a small silver locket on a chain.

fields.action_text: Step through the mirror into the reflected world
fields.success_text: You place your palm against the intact mirror's surface and speak a word of Passage. The glass ripples like water, and you step through into a perfect reflection of the gallery — but here, everything is reversed and untouched by time. On a pedestal in the center of this mirror-world stands a crystal decanter filled with shimmering coins. You claim them and step back through the mirror, returning to your own world.

fields.action_text: Force open the locked box beside the brazier
fields.failure_text: You grab the box and try to pry it open. The lock holds fast, but the heat from the brazier has made the metal unbearably hot. Your hands blister and burn, and the box hits the ground with a loud clang.
fields.mixed_text: You grab the box and try to pry it open. The lock holds fast, but the heat from the brazier has made the metal unbearably hot. Your hands blister and burn. Upon hitting the ground, the box breaks open and spills its contents on the floor — a small gilded figurine, praying.
fields.success_text: You use a piece of cloth to protect your hands from the heat and work the lock carefully. It breaks open, revealing a small gilded figurine, praying.

fields.action_text: Walk past the altar and enter the narrow passage
fields.success_text: You move carefully between the candles, making sure not to disturb their arrangement. The flames dance but do not react. You reach the passage and continue onward.

fields.action_text: Pull aside the confessional curtain and look inside
fields.failure_text: You draw back the curtain and peer into the darkness within. A voice whispers from the shadows — not words, but something deeper and more terrible. The sound burrows into your mind, and you feel a sharp pain behind your eyes. You stumble backward, clutching your head. You have been judged.
fields.mixed_text: You draw back the curtain and peer into the darkness within. The booth is empty except for a small leather pouch resting on the wooden seat. As you reach for it, the curtain suddenly wraps around your arm, moving as if it were alive. Its fabric burns hot against your skin. You manage to tear yourself free, clutching the pouch.
fields.success_text: You draw back the curtain and peer into the darkness within. The booth is empty except for a small leather pouch resting on the wooden seat. You take it and step away.

fields.action_text: Command the flames to extinguish
fields.success_text: You mutter a word of Ending, and every candle in the chapel goes dark at once. In the sudden blackness, you hear a soft grinding of stone. When you conjure a small light, you see that the altar has shifted aside, revealing a hidden compartment beneath. Inside rests an ornate reliquary containing ancient coins and precious stones untouched by time.

fields.action_text: Drink from the chalice on the pedestal
fields.failure_text: You lift the chalice and bring it to your lips. The liquid burns like poison as it goes down, and your vision blurs. You drop the chalice and collapse to your knees, retching.
fields.mixed_text: You lift the chalice and take a cautious sip. The liquid tastes bitter and wrong, but as you swallow, you feel a strange warmth spread through your chest. At the bottom of the chalice, you find several small gold coins that clink as you retrieve them. The warmth fades, leaving you dizzy and weak.
fields.success_text: You lift the chalice carefully and peer inside before drinking. Beneath the dark liquid, you see the glint of gold coins. You pour out the liquid and claim the treasure hidden within.

fields.action_text: Push open the carved wooden door and pass through
fields.failure_text: You push against the door, and it swings open with a loud creak. As you step through, the carved vines writhe to life and reach for you, directed by some dark magic. Thorns tear at your clothes and skin, drawing blood before you can pull free.
fields.mixed_text: You push against the door carefully, and it opens. As you pass through, one of the carved thorns catches your arm, leaving a shallow cut.
fields.success_text: You examine the carvings closely before pushing the door. You notice a pattern in the vines and press your hand to a smooth section. The door swings open gently, and you pass through unharmed.

fields.action_text: Walk through the bone archway into shadow
fields.success_text: You approach the archway formed by carefully arranged bones. Despite their macabre appearance, they remain still and lifeless. You pass through without incident.

fields.action_text: Command the bones to reveal their secrets
fields.success_text: You focus your energy and cast a spell Revealing. The skeletal hands throughout the room begin to move, twisting and pointing toward a section of wall that looks no different from the rest. You approach and find that the bones there are false — carved from wood and painted white. Behind them is a hidden alcove containing a jeweled skull worth a small fortune.

fields.action_text: Walk through the grand archway into the darkness
fields.failure_text: You stride toward the archway confidently. As you pass beneath it, your foot catches on a nearly invisible tripwire. You hear a sharp *twang* and a volley of rusted crossbow bolts fires from hidden slots in the walls. Several find their mark.
fields.mixed_text: You stride toward the archway confidently. As you pass beneath it, your foot catches on a nearly invisible tripwire. You hear a sharp *twang* as a single rusted crossbow bolt fires from a hidden slot in the wall.
fields.success_text: You approach the archway slowly, examining the floor and walls for traps. You spot a thin wire stretched across the threshold and step over it carefully.

fields.action_text: Search the cold fireplace for something hidden
fields.success_text: You step into the hearth and examine the stonework carefully. One stone near the back feels different—smoother, more worn. You press it, and with a deep grinding sound, the fireplace's back wall swings open, revealing a narrow passage beyond. You step through into darkness.

fields.action_text: Gather the silver candlesticks from the tables
fields.failure_text: You begin collecting the candlesticks, moving from table to table. As you reach for one particularly ornate piece, something shifts beneath the dust. The candlestick is attached to a hidden wire, and pulling it triggers a mechanism overhead. A heavy chandelier crashes down, striking you across the back and shoulders.
fields.mixed_text: You begin collecting the candlesticks, moving from table to table. As you reach for one particularly ornate piece, something shifts beneath the dust. The candlestick is attached to a hidden wire, and pulling it triggers a mechanism overhead. A heavy chandelier crashes down, striking your arm. You manage to keep hold of the candlesticks you've gathered.
fields.success_text: You move methodically through the hall, testing each candlestick before taking it. You gather a collection of the finest pieces, their silver still gleaming beneath the dust. They'll fetch a good price.

fields.action_text: Cast a spell of Time to conjure the memory of an ancient feast
fields.success_text: The room shimmers, and for a moment you see the banquet as it was — tables laden with golden plates, nobles laughing, servants pouring wine. As the vision fades, you notice that one of the nobles left behind a heavy purse on the table. You reach for it and find it solid and real: a fortune in ancient gold coins that somehow survived the passage of time.

fields.action_text: Climb through the rubble of the collapsed cell
fields.failure_text: You climb over the broken stone and twisted metal. You try to move carefully, but your weight shifts a piece of debris and the pile collapses beneath you. Sharp edges of iron and stone tear at your flesh as you tumble through into a hidden passage.
fields.mixed_text: You climb over the broken stone and twisted metal. You try to move carefully, but your weight shifts a piece of debris and the pile collapses beneath you as you tumble through into a hidden passage. On the other side, you find a small leather bag of coins, probably hidden by a desperate prisoner long ago.
fields.success_text: You climb through the rubble methodically, testing each foothold before committing your weight. You climb into a hidden passage and discover a small hollow containing a leather bag of coins, probably hidden by a desperate prisoner long ago.

fields.action_text: Enter the cell with blood-painted symbols and examine them closely
fields.failure_text: You step into the cell and lean close to study the symbols. As your eyes follow their twisted patterns, the symbols seem to writhe and burn themselves into your vision. You begin to hear the sound of hundreds of disembodies voices crying out at once. You stagger out of the cell, clutching your head as pain explodes behind your eyes.
fields.mixed_text: You step cautiously into the cell and study the symbols from a safe distance. They seem to form some kind of protective ward or binding circle. In the center of the pattern, you notice a loose stone in the floor. You pry it up, expecting to find a treasure hidden long ago by whatever prisoner had painted these desperate wards. Empty.
fields.success_text: You step cautiously into the cell and study the symbols from a safe distance. They seem to form some kind of protective ward or binding circle. In the center of the pattern, you notice a loose stone in the floor. You pry it up and find a small cache of coins and a tarnished amulet on a chain, likely placed there for safekeeping by whatever prisoner painted these desperate wards.

fields.action_text: Speak to the echoes of those who suffered here
fields.success_text: You mutter a word of Reflection, and the air begins to shimmer. You hear whispered voices — hundreds of them, overlapping in desperation and sorrow. They tell you secrets in broken fragments: where the guards hid their bribes, where prisoners stashed stolen treasures, where the warden kept his keys. When the voices fade, you follow their directions to a loose stone in the corridor wall. Behind it: a iron lockbox containing the warden's collection of confiscated valuables.

fields.action_text: Place your hand upon the altar
fields.failure_text: You press your palm against the cold obsidian. Immediately, the etched symbols flare bright, and you feel something ancient and hungry reach for you through the stone. Pain explodes through your arm as the altar drinks deeply. You scream and tear yourself away, blood pouring from your hand. The ritual has begun.
fields.mixed_text: You press your palm against the cold obsidian. Immediately, the etched symbols flare bright, and you feel something ancient and hungry reach for you through the stone. The altar grabs you, and you feel your life essence being drained. Just then, a hidden compartment in the altar`s base slides open. Inside, you find a collection of dark gemstones that seem to absorb light. You take the prize, but are forever changed.
fields.success_text: You examine the altar carefully before touching it. You notice a specific symbol that appears different from the others. When you press it, a hidden compartment in the altar`s base slides open. Inside, you find a collection of dark gemstones that seem to absorb light.

fields.action_text: Pass through the iron door into shadow
fields.success_text: You step carefully around the ritual circles, avoiding the runes entirely. The iron door stands open, and you pass through into the darkness beyond without disturbing whatever power lingers here.

fields.action_text: Descend the narrow spiral staircase into the depths
fields.failure_text: You begin your descent into the cold darkness below. Suddenly, a shrieking mass of bats erupts from the depths, their wings beating against your face and body. You lose your footing entirely and tumble violently down the stairs, crashing against stone again and again until finally reaching the bottom.
fields.mixed_text: You begin your descent into the cold darkness below. Suddenly, a shrieking mass of bats erupts from the depths, their wings beating against your face and body. You stumble backward, catching yourself against the wall but scraping your side badly against the rough stone. Shaken, you continue your descent more carefully.
fields.success_text: You take the stairs slowly, one hand on the wall for balance. You hear the flutter of wings below and press yourself against the wall as a swarm of bats rushes past you up the stairwell. Once they've passed, you continue your descent and reach the passage below safely.

fields.action_text: Disrupt the ritual circle and claim its power for yourself
fields.success_text: You speak words of Unmaking. The runes on the floor begin to glow brighter and brighter before flaring out in an explosion of green wisps. The candles extinguish, and the altar cracks down the middle. In the sudden darkness you hear something scream in rage. When light returns, you find that the altar has split open completely, revealing its hollow interior filled with offerings of gold, jewels, and artifacts of dark power left by countless supplicants.

fields.action_text: Search through the specimen jars for anything valuable
fields.failure_text: You examine the jars, looking for anything worth taking. As you lift one particularly large specimen jar, the glass shatters in your hands. The preserved creature inside — something with too many teeth — is not as dead as you thought. It latches onto your arm, biting deep before you can tear it away and crush it underfoot.
fields.mixed_text: You examine the jars, looking for anything worth taking. As you lift one particularly large specimen jar, the glass shatters in your hands. The preserved creature inside — something with too many teeth — is not as dead as you thought. It latches onto your arm, biting deep before you can tear it away and crush it underfoot. In the commotion, a small lockbox falls to the ground and you hastily take the valuables inside.
fields.success_text: You examine the shelves methodically. Behind a row of specimens, you find a small locked box containing a collection of gold teeth and small gemstones — payment for services rendered, perhaps.

fields.action_text: Pass through the archway and leave this cursed place
fields.success_text: You step carefully around the tables and their disturbing tools, avoiding the worst of the stains on the floor. The archway leads onward, and you pass through gratefully.

fields.action_text: Slide down the metal chute into darkness
fields.failure_text: You lower yourself into the chute and begin your descent. The metal is slick, and you pick up speed rapidly. You crash into something hard at the bottom — a pile of discarded bones and failed experiments. The impact drives broken ribs and shattered skulls into your back and legs.
fields.mixed_text: You slide down the chute, trying to control your speed with your hands and feet. The metal tears at your palms, and you crash roughly into a pile of refuse at the bottom. Amid the debris, you find a leather coin purse that once belonged to someone who came before you.
fields.success_text: You ease yourself into the chute and descend in a controlled slide, using your feet against the sides to control your speed. You land in a pile of discarded materials at the bottom, rolling to absorb the impact. Among the refuse, you find valuables dropped by previous victims.

fields.action_text: Unmake the Fleshcrafter's work and free what remains trapped here
fields.success_text: You speak words of Ending, and every jar in the room shatters at once. The specimens dissolve into harmless dust, and the tortured essence trapped within them disperses with grateful whispers. The chained cabinet bursts open, revealing the Fleshcrafter`s payment hoard—decades of gold, jewels, and forbidden texts once belonging to the countless victims of this place.

fields.action_text: Pass through the barred gate
fields.success_text: You walk past the swaying nooses, keeping your eyes forward and your breathing steady. The barred gate stands open, and you pass through into the area beyond.

fields.action_text: Climb the ladder to the scaffolding near the ceiling
fields.failure_text: You begin climbing the ladder toward the scaffolding above. Halfway up, one of the hanging nooses suddenly swings toward you as if pulled by invisible hands. The rope wraps around your neck and tightens. You struggle desperately, finally managing to tear it loose and tumble back down the ladder, landing hard on the stained floor below.
fields.mixed_text: You climb the ladder steadily, timing your movements to avoid the swaying nooses. You reach the scaffolding and see a door at the other end. You pass through undisturbed.
fields.success_text: You climb the ladder steadily, timing your movements to avoid the swaying nooses. You reach the scaffolding and find a small box hidden in the rafters—payment left by someone who escaped their sentence.

fields.action_text: Read the ledger at the base of the podium
fields.failure_text: You kneel and begin reading the names inscribed in the ledger—hundreds of them, each followed by their crime and sentence. As your eyes move down the page, you realize with growing horror that the handwriting is changing, becoming fresher. Your own name appears on the page, written in wet ink. You feel cold hands close around your throat from behind — the executed claiming their revenge. You tear yourself away, gasping and bruised, turning to strike at whatever has attacked you. You stand in the courtroom alone.
fields.mixed_text: You kneel and flip through the ledger carefully. Most pages list executions, but near the end you find an accounting of bribes paid to corrupt judges. Tucked between the pages is a small purse of coins — evidence never submitted. You feel cold hands close around your throat from behind — the executed claiming their revenge. You tear yourself away, turning to strike at whatever has attacked you. You stand in the courtroom alone.
fields.success_text: You examine the ledger carefully, avoiding reading too deeply into any single page. Near the back, you find an accounting of bribes and hidden payments. Tucked between the pages is a purse of coins and a signet ring bearing a judge's seal.

fields.action_text: Pass judgment on those who judged unjustly
fields.success_text: You speak words of Condemnation, and the chamber responds. The nooses rise into the air, and for a moment you see ghostly forms suspended from them — not the executed, but the executioners and corrupt judges who sent innocent souls to death. They writhe and vanish, their screams fading into silence. The broken podium splits open, revealing a hidden compartment where bribes and blood money were stored for centuries.

fields.action_text: Sprint for the double doors
fields.failure_text: You break into a run as the taxidermied animals spring to life. The bear crashes down from its pedestal, claws extended. A wolf leaps from the wall, jaws snapping. They converge on you before you reach the doors, teeth and claws tearing at your flesh. You manage to land several strikes upon them before crashing through the doors. The beasts freeze in place as you cross the threshold, bleeding and mauled.
fields.mixed_text: You break into a run as the taxidermied animals spring to life. The bear crashes down from its pedestal, claws extended. A wolf leaps from the wall, jaws snapping. You feel claws rake across your back. You draw your weapon and manage to land several strikes on the beast before rushing through the doors and slamming them shut behind you.
fields.success_text: You break into a run as the taxidermied animals spring to life. The bear crashes down from its pedestal, claws extended. A wolf leaps from the wall, jaws snapping. You duck and sway, then strike the creatures with your weapon. While you have the chance, you sprint for the doors and slam them shut behind you.

fields.action_text: Duck into the narrow servants' passage
fields.success_text: You see the mounted creatures beginning to stir and immediately dart into the servants' passage. It's too narrow for the larger animals to follow. You hear them snarling and clawing at the entrance behind you as you hurry through to safety.

fields.action_text: Smash open the display cases and take what you can
fields.failure_text: You rush to the display cases and begin smashing the glass. The sound triggers the mounted creatures immediately. They spring to life in a frenzy, converging on the noise. You're torn away from the cases, savaged by dead things given terrible life. You crawl towards the exit.
fields.mixed_text: You move to the nearest display case and shatter the glass quickly. Your hands close around valuable trophies — claws tipped in gold, fangs set with jewels. The sound awakens the creatures, and you feel teeth sink into your shoulder as you grab your prizes. You take out your weapon, strike the creature, and run for the exit.
fields.success_text: You approach the display cases cautiously and select the most valuable pieces — claws tipped in gold, fangs set with jewels, preserved wings edged in silver. You work quickly and quietly. The mounted creatures stir and twitch, turning toward you, but you pocket your prizes and slip away before they fully animate.

fields.action_text: Command the dead to return to stillness
fields.success_text: The taxidermied animals spring to life in a frenzy. The bear crashes down from its pedestal, claws extended. A wolf leaps from the wall, jaws snapping. You speak words of Binding, and every creature in the room freezes mid-motion — some already lunging, caught in midair. Others are just beginning to stir. They become lifeless once more. You walk among them safely and discover what the hunter valued most: a hidden cabinet containing his rarest prizes — exotic pelts, ivory tusks, and jeweled collars worth a fortune.

fields.action_text: Crawl through the collapsed section of wall
fields.failure_text: You approach the collapsed section and begin squeezing through the gap. As you pass through, the walls suddenly constrict—the stone itself moving like muscle. You`re crushed between the bleeding stones, ribs cracking before the pressure releases and you fall through to the other side.
fields.mixed_text: You approach the collapsed section and begin squeezing through the gap. As you pass through, the walls suddenly constrict — the stone itself moving like muscle. You're crushed between the bleeding stones as you move. On the other side, you find a small alcove where someone once hid from whatever haunts these halls. They left behind a pouch of coins.
fields.success_text: You crawl through the collapsed section methodically, watching for any sign of movement in the stone. You emerge into a small alcove on the other side. Someone once hid here — their skeleton still clutches a pouch of coins and a silver pendant.

fields.action_text: Press your hand into the circular relief on the stone door
fields.failure_text: You place your palm against the center of the relief. Immediately, you feel something pierce your skin — dozens of tiny needles emerging from the carved stone. Blood flows from your hand into the grooves, and the door begins to drink. You tear yourself away, your hand torn and bleeding. Satisfied, the door swings open.
fields.mixed_text: You place your palm against the center of the relief. Immediately, you feel something pierce your skin — dozens of tiny needles emerging from the carved stone. Blood flows from your hand into the grooves. Satisfied, the door swings open. Beyond lies a small chamber containing valuables left as offerings.
fields.success_text: You examine the relief closely and notice that the outermost ring is slightly raised. You press it first, and the mechanism clicks. The inner rings rotate, and the door swings open without requiring blood. Beyond lies a small chamber containing offerings — coins, jewelry, and ornate daggers.

fields.action_text: Walk carefully through the blood to the archway
fields.success_text: You step carefully around the worst of the pooling blood, staying close to the center of the corridor. The walls pulse and weep around you, but nothing emerges. You reach the archway without incident.

fields.action_text: Cauterize the wounds in the stone and stop the bleeding
fields.success_text: You speak a word of Flame, and the walls cease their weeping as fire engulfs the area. The blood stops flowing, the cracks seal themselves, and the flames die. In the sudden silence, you hear something fall behind the stone door — the mechanism no longer sustained by blood. The door swings open on its own, revealing a hidden treasury where centuries of blood offerings were stored: gold coins stained dark, jeweled chalices used in rituals, and artifacts of power.

fields.action_text: Force open the sealed iron vault
fields.failure_text: You wrench at the vault door with all your strength. The mechanism inside suddenly activates, and white-hot steam erupts from vents around the door's edge, scalding your face and hands. You stumble backward, burned.
fields.mixed_text: You work at the vault's mechanism carefully, using tools from the workbench. The door finally groans open, but as it does, scalding steam vents from the sides, burning your arm. Inside the vault: ingots of precious metals and bags of rare coins used as raw materials.
fields.success_text: You examine the vault door closely and notice cooling vents around its edge. You wedge them open with tools first, releasing the built-up pressure safely. The door swings open to reveal ingots of gold and silver, bags of rare coins, and completed chains of exquisite craftsmanship.

fields.action_text: Pass through the soot-blackened doorway
fields.success_text: You step carefully around the scattered metal scraps and tools, avoiding the worst of the debris. The doorway is wide and clear, and you pass through without trouble.

fields.action_text: Climb the chains to reach the hanging cage
fields.failure_text: You grab the thick chains and begin climbing toward the cage above. The metal is still hot from the forge`s residual heat, searing your palms. Halfway up, your grip fails and you plummet down, crashing onto an anvil below.
fields.mixed_text: You grab the thick chains and begin climbing toward the cage above. The metal is still hot from the forge's residual heat, searing your palms. You reach the cage and find a collection of fine jewelry inside — samples of the chainmaker's craft.
fields.success_text: You wrap cloth around your hands to protect against the heat and climb steadily. Inside the hanging cage, you find a collection of fine jewelry — necklaces, bracelets, and rings of precious metals, likely the chainmaker's finest work displayed as advertisement. You descend carefully with your treasure.

fields.action_text: Rekindle the forge and command it to work
fields.success_text: You speak words of Creation, and the cold coals burst into flame. The anvils begin to ring with invisible hammers, and chains lift themselves from the floor, linking together in intricate patterns. When the forge cools again, you find it has created something new: chains of pure gold woven with gemstones.

fields.action_text: Pull the levers on the control panel
fields.failure_text: You begin pulling levers at random. The court roars to life — but violently, chaotically. The copper knight draws its sword and charges at you. Courtiers grab with mechanical hands. The crowned figure rises from its throne, scepter striking down. You draw your weapon and fight desperately, striking at gears and joints, but the automatons overwhelm you. You`re battered and cut before finally managing to flee.
fields.mixed_text: You study the control panel and carefully pull what seems like the correct sequence. Most of the court powers down safely, but the copper knight's mechanism misfires. Its sword swings wide toward you, and you raise your weapon to parry. The impact sends the knight crashing backward, but not before its blade slices your shoulder. Inside its hollow torso, you find valuable components made of precious metals.
fields.success_text: You study the control panel methodically and notice a pattern of symbols labelling the mechanisms. You pull the correct sequence of levers, and the figures settle into resting positions. Compartments in their hollow bodies reveal valuable mechanical parts — gears of gold, springs of silver, jeweled clockwork hearts.

fields.action_text: Descend into the maintenance shaft
fields.success_text: You lower yourself into the narrow maintenance shaft, climbing down a metal ladder. The shaft leads to a passage below, away from the mechanical court.

fields.action_text: Open the decorated double doors
fields.failure_text: You push the doors open carefully, but the movement activates a defensive mechanism. Mechanical arms extend from the door's decorated surface and attack. You stagger through the doors, bleeding from dozens of shallow cuts.
fields.mixed_text: You push the doors open carefully, but the movement activates a defensive mechanism. Mechanical arms extend from the door's decorated surface and attack. You stagger through the doors, bleeding from dozens of shallow cuts. Beyond lies a workshop containing tools and materials of precious metals.
fields.success_text: You examine the door's mechanical reliefs closely and notice pressure plates around its frame. You wedge them carefully before pushing, disabling the mechanism. The doors open smoothly, revealing a workshop beyond containing tools and materials of precious metals.

fields.action_text: Command the court to perform
fields.success_text: You speak words of Animation, and every mechanical figure comes to life in perfect harmony. The courtiers dance in synchronized patterns, the knight demonstrates combat forms, and the crowned figure rises to deliver a silent speech. They perform an elaborate court ceremony before winding down naturally. In their final positions, they reveal hidden compartments throughout the room containing the artisan's fortune—rare materials, finished pieces, and payment for commissions never delivered.

fields.action_text: Descend the carved steps into the well
fields.failure_text: You descend the steps to where they meet the water. You can see an iron lockbox just beneath the surface, wedged between stones. You reach into the water, and something in the depths senses the disturbance — cold hands grab your wrist and pull. You're dragged into the black water, thrashing as the creature tries to drown you. You fight desperately, striking at it with your weapon until it releases you. You drag yourself back up the steps, half-drowned and bleeding from deep scratches.
fields.mixed_text: You descend the steps to where they meet the water. You can see an iron lockbox just beneath the surface, wedged between stones. You reach into the water, and something in the depths senses the disturbance — cold hands grab your wrist and pull. You're dragged into the black water, thrashing as the creature tries to drown you. You wrench free with the box clutched in your hand and climb back up, bleeding from deep scratches.
fields.success_text: You descend the steps to where they meet the water. You can see an iron lockbox just beneath the surface, wedged between stones. You reach into the water, and retrieve the box silently. Inside is a stash of old coins and the remains of a scrawled note, waterlogged and unreadable.

fields.action_text: Pass through the metal gate
fields.success_text: You step carefully around the well's edge, keeping your distance from the opening. The metal gate stands open just wide enough to slip through. You pass into the corridor beyond without incident.

fields.action_text: Operate the winch to raise what's chained below
fields.failure_text: You begin turning the winch, and the chain rises slowly from the depths. Something heavy is attached to the end. As it emerges dripping from the well, you see it — a cage containing the skeletal remains of someone who died down there. The bones begin to creak and stir. Suddenly, they lunge through the rusted bars, grabbing at you with impossible strength. You fight back desperately, finally kicking the cage back into the well, but not before bony fingers tear at your flesh.
fields.mixed_text: You work the winch carefully, raising the chain. A locked iron box emerges from the depths, dripping and covered in slime. You manage to pry it open and find coins and jewelry inside — valuables thrown down as offerings or hidden from thieves. As you pocket them, your hand slips on the wet mechanism and the winch's handle spins violently backward, crushing your fingers.
fields.success_text: You examine the winch before operating it and notice a locking mechanism to prevent backlash. You engage it, then turn the crank steadily. An iron box rises from the water below. You retrieve it carefully and find it filled with coins, jewelry, and small valuables — either offerings thrown into the well or treasure hidden in its depths.

fields.action_text: Drain the well and reveal what lies at its bottom
fields.success_text: You speak words of Emptying, and the water begins to rush away through hidden channels. The level drops rapidly, revealing the well's true depth. At the very bottom, among bones and debris, you find what was lost over decades — coins, jewelry, weapons, and artifacts thrown or dropped into the well. A fortune in salvage lies waiting to be claimed.

fields.action_text: Open the iron-banded door at the corridor's end
fields.success_text: You approach the heavy door and study the carving. Carefully, you push against it with your shoulder. It resists at first, then swings open with a groan of protesting hinges. You pass through into the space beyond.

fields.action_text: Reveal the tapestries' hidden meaning.
fields.success_text: You raise your hand and speak a word of Revealing. An energy fills the room and the tapestries begin to move as if stirred by a great wind. Their woven depictions come to life, each telling the story of an ancient kingdom's rise and fall. As the scenes conclude, a small section of the wall begins to shift, revealing a long-forgotten alcove and the last remnants of a treasure lost to time. You take what you can and move on.

fields.action_text: Reveal the blessing and avoid judgment
fields.success_text: You close your eyes and speak a word of Purity. As you do so, the tattered offerings burn away and the dark stains on the floor slowly vanish. This place of harsh judgment has been cleansed. A hidden compartment at the base of the stone bench slides open, revealing an offering of polished coins.

fields.action_text: Command the ancient mechanism into action
fields.success_text: You walk into the center of the room and stand before the fountain. You mutter a word of Command and feel a shaking beneath your feet. Suddenly, water begins to pour down the carved channels of the walls and into the fountain, filling it up. The water begins to sparkle as coins of all shapes and sizes stir up from the bottom.
